description: This file defines an authentication context for a React application using Supabase. It provides a provider component, hooks for accessing authentication state, and functions for signing in and out, managing user sessions, and role derivation.

methods.name: AuthProvider
methods.description: React functional component providing authentication context to child components, managing user session state, and handling authentication actions.

methods.name: useAuth
methods.description: Custom hook for accessing authentication context, throws error if used outside of AuthProvider.

methods.name: useRole
methods.description: Hook to derive the current user's role from its metadata, if available.

methods.name: useSupabaseAuth
methods.description: Alias for useAuth, maintained for backward compatibility.

methods.name: signInWithEmail
methods.description: Function to initiate sign-in with email, sending a magic link to the user.

methods.name: signInWithGoogle
methods.description: Optional function to initiate Google OAuth sign-in if Google client ID is configured.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Function to sign out the current user.
